description: NASSCOM is the premier trade body and chamber of commerce of the IT-BPM industries in India. Founded in 1988 by industry leaders including Harish Mehta, Ashank Desai, Nandan Nilekani, KV Ramani and Saurabh Srivastava, it represents over 3,000 member companies.

name: Thane Belapur Industries Association (TBIA)
short_description: Regional industry association representing units in TTC MIDC area.
description: TBIA was established to represent industries in TTC MIDC area; interacts with government bodies for industry issues; runs sub-committees and common projects.

name: Brew & Blend Master Franchise
short_description: Brew & Blend is a premier coffee and bakery brand offering exclusive regional/state master franchise rights.
description: Brew & Blend is a premier coffee and bakery brand offering exclusive regional/state master franchise rights.

name: Confederation of Indian Industry (CII)
short_description: India's leading industry association driving competitiveness and sustainable growth.
description: CII works to create and sustain an environment conducive to the development of India. A non-government, not-for-profit, industry-led and industry-managed organisation, it plays a proactive role in India's development process.

name: Associated Chambers of Commerce & Industry of India (ASSOCHAM)
short_description: One of India's premier apex trade and industry bodies.
description: ASSOCHAM, established in 1920 by a group of chambers led by the Calcutta Traders Association, is one of the oldest and most reputed apex trade and industry bodies in India, representing over 4.5 lakh direct and indirect members.

name: PHD Chamber of Commerce and Industry (PHDCCI)
short_description: A proactive and dynamic apex organisation representing north Indian industry.
description: PHD Chamber of Commerce and Industry, established in 1905, is a proactive multi-State apex organisation working at the grass-root level with strong national and international linkages, with a direct membership of over 1,30,000.

name: Federation of Indian Export Organisations (FIEO)
short_description: Apex body of Indian export promotion organisations.
description: FIEO is the apex trade promotion organisation in India, set up jointly by the Ministry of Commerce & Industry, Government of India, and private trade and industry in 1965. It serves the interests of about 200,000 exporters directly and indirectly.

name: Internet and Mobile Association of India (IAMAI)
short_description: Industry body for digital business in India.
description: IAMAI is a non-profit industry body established in 2004 to expand and enhance the online and mobile value-added services sectors. It advocates for a conducive policy environment for the internet and digital industry in India.

name: Manufacturers Association for Information Technology (MAIT)
short_description: Apex industry body representing the IT hardware sector.
description: MAIT is the apex body for the IT hardware, training, R&D, and associated services industry in India. It was established in 1982 to represent the IT product industry and promote domestic manufacturing.

name: Data Security Council of India (DSCI)
short_description: India's premier data protection and cybersecurity industry body.
description: DSCI is a not-for-profit, industry body on data protection in India, setup by NASSCOM. It works with governments, regulators and industry to promote cybersecurity and privacy best practices, standards, and frameworks.

name: Indian Drug Manufacturers' Association (IDMA)
short_description: Apex body representing India's pharmaceutical manufacturing industry.
description: IDMA, founded in 1961, is the largest and most representative apex organisation for the pharmaceutical manufacturing sector in India, amalgamating 8 State Boards with over 11,000 members across the country.

name: Organisation of Pharmaceutical Producers of India (OPPI)
short_description: Apex body of research-based pharmaceutical companies in India.
description: OPPI is the apex body of research-based global pharmaceutical companies in India, established in 1965. Member firms account for around 60% of the total pharmaceuticals market and 50% of drug export industry.

name: Indian Pharmaceutical Alliance (IPA)
short_description: Alliance of India's leading domestic pharmaceutical companies.
description: IPA was founded in August 1999 by Dilip G Shah along with Cipla, Dr. Reddy's, Lupin, Piramal, Ranbaxy and Wockhardt to promote the cause of generic drugs in India. It now represents 24 leading Indian pharma companies.

name: All India Organisation of Chemists & Druggists (AIOCD)
short_description: National body of licensed drug retail chemists and druggists.
description: AIOCD is the national apex organisation for licensed chemists and druggists in India, established in 1961, representing about 800,000 members - stockists, pharmacies and retailers across the country.

name: Pharmaceuticals Export Promotion Council of India (PHARMEXCIL)
short_description: Government-backed council promoting India's pharmaceutical exports.
description: PHARMEXCIL was set up in 2004 by the Ministry of Commerce & Industry to boost India's pharma exports, assisting member companies through market studies, trade delegations, and global trade fair participation.

name: Automotive Component Manufacturers Association of India (ACMA)
short_description: Apex body of auto component manufacturers in India.
description: ACMA is the apex industry body representing the interests of the automotive component industry in India, representing the USD 80.2 billion auto component industry comprising organised players and SMEs.

name: Federation of Automobile Dealers Associations (FADA)
short_description: National body for automobile dealers in India.
description: FADA, founded in 1964, is the apex national body of the automobile retail industry in India, representing over 15,000 automobile dealerships and 30,000+ outlets, accounting for around 90% of market share.

name: Confederation of Indian Textile Industry (CITI)
short_description: Apex body of the entire Indian textile industry.
description: CITI is the apex body of the entire Indian textile industry, founded in 1942, representing the complete value chain from cotton farmers and spinning units to garment exporters and textile machinery makers.

name: Apparel Export Promotion Council (AEPC)
short_description: Government body promoting India's apparel exports globally.
description: AEPC is the official body of apparel exporters in India, incorporated in 1978 under the Foreign Trade (Development and Regulation) Act, operating under the Ministry of Textiles to promote garment exports.

name: Cotton Textiles Export Promotion Council (TEXPROCIL)
short_description: Apex body for promotion of cotton textile exports from India.
description: TEXPROCIL, set up in 1954, is the apex export promotion body for cotton textiles from India, assisting member exporters with market information and representation to government bodies.

name: Chemicals & Allied Products Export Promotion Council (CAPEXIL)
short_description: Export promotion body for chemicals and allied products.
description: CAPEXIL, set up in March 1958 by the Ministry of Commerce & Industry, promotes exports of chemicals, dyes, ceramics, paper, rubber and other allied products from India.

name: Indian Chemical Council (ICC)
short_description: National body for India's chemical industry.
description: Indian Chemical Council (ICC) is the apex body of the Indian chemical industry, representing manufacturers and promoting sustainable practices within the sector, publishing an 84th Annual Report for 2024-25.

name: Engineering Export Promotion Council of India (EEPC India)
short_description: Premier export promotion body for engineering goods.
description: EEPC India, set up in 1955, is the premier export promotion body for engineering goods, products and services in India, serving over 12,000 members through regional offices across the country.

name: Indian Electrical & Electronics Manufacturers' Association (IEEMA)
short_description: Apex body of electrical and electronic equipment manufacturers.
description: IEEMA is the representative body of manufacturers of electrical, industrial electronics and allied equipment in India, established in 1948. Members contribute over 90% of installed electrical equipment in the country with combined turnover exceeding USD 50 billion.

name: Indian Machine Tool Manufacturers' Association (IMTMA)
short_description: Apex body representing India's machine tool industry.
description: IMTMA, founded in 1946, is the apex body of machine tool manufacturers in India, promoting the industry for nearly eight decades and organising IMTEX, one of Asia's premier machine tool exhibitions.

name: All India Plastics Manufacturers Association (AIPMA)
short_description: Largest body of plastics manufacturers in Asia.
description: AIPMA is the largest and most representative body of the plastics industry in Asia, established in 1945, known for organising Plastivision India - the country's leading plastics exhibition.

name: Indian Plastics Institute (IPI)
short_description: Professional body for the plastics industry in India.
description: The Indian Plastics Institute (IPI) is a professional body established in 1967 that promotes the development of the plastics industry through technical seminars, exhibitions, and publications. It bridges academia and industry in the plastics sector.

name: Confederation of Real Estate Developers' Associations of India (CREDAI)
short_description: Apex body of private real estate developers in India.
description: CREDAI, established in 1999, is the apex body for private real estate developers in India, advocating for the housing sector with state chapters and youth/women's wings nationwide.

name: National Real Estate Development Council (NAREDCO)
short_description: Self-regulatory body under Ministry of Housing for real estate.
description: NAREDCO is an autonomous self-regulatory body for real estate developers, established in 1998 under the aegis of the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, with the Union Minister as Ex-officio Chief Patron.

name: Indian Banks' Association (IBA)
short_description: Collective voice of the banking industry in India.
description: Indian Banks' Association, founded in 1946 and headquartered in Mumbai, is a voluntary association of banks promoting coordination, standardization and transparency in India's banking sector.

name: Association of Mutual Funds in India (AMFI)
short_description: Umbrella body of the Indian mutual fund industry.
description: AMFI is the apex body of all SEBI-registered Asset Management Companies, established in 1995, dedicated to developing the Indian mutual fund industry on professional, healthy and ethical lines.

name: Bombay Stock Exchange Brokers' Forum (BBF)
short_description: Association of BSE-registered stock brokers.
description: BBF represents the interests of members registered with the Bombay Stock Exchange. It works to facilitate efficient capital market operations and brokers' welfare and has been active since 1996.

name: Life Insurance Council
short_description: Collective body of life insurance companies in India.
description: The Life Insurance Council, constituted under the Insurance Act 1938, is the representative body for all life insurance companies in India. It promotes the interests of policyholders and the broader life insurance industry.

name: Indian Medical Association (IMA)
short_description: National voluntary organisation of physicians of modern scientific medicine.
description: IMA, established in 1928 (originally All India Medical Association, renamed 1930), is the largest association of medical doctors in India with approximately 350,000 member doctors across 1,700 active local branches in 29 states/UTs.

name: Indian Nursing Council (INC)
short_description: Statutory body regulating nursing education in India.
description: Indian Nursing Council is a statutory body constituted under the Indian Nursing Council Act 1947. It regulates and maintains uniform standards of nursing education and reciprocity with other countries regarding mutual recognition of nursing qualifications.

name: National Accreditation Board for Hospitals & Healthcare Providers (NABH)
short_description: Constituent board of QCI for accreditation of hospitals.
description: NABH is a constituent board of Quality Council of India (QCI), set up to establish and operate accreditation programme for healthcare organisations. It helps patients to choose the best hospitals and motivates hospitals to improve quality of care.

name: Dental Council of India (DCI)
short_description: Statutory body regulating dental education in India.
description: The Dental Council of India is a statutory body established under the Dentists Act, 1948. It regulates the dental education and dental practice in India, maintains the Indian Dental Register, and grants recognition to dental degrees.

name: Hotel Association of India (HAI)
short_description: Apex body of approved hotels in India.
description: Hotel Association of India (HAI) is the apex organisation for the hotel and hospitality industry in India. Founded in 1996, it represents star-rated hotels and works with government on policy matters related to hospitality.

name: Federation of Hotel & Restaurant Associations of India (FHRAI)
short_description: Apex body of hotels and restaurants in India.
description: FHRAI, founded in 1955 by legendary hotelier Rai Bahadur M.S. Oberoi, is the apex body of hotels and restaurants in India, representing 1,00,000 hotels and 5,00,000 restaurants nationwide.

name: Travel Agents Federation of India (TAFI)
short_description: Pan India body of travel agents.
description: TAFI is a pan-India federation of travel agents established in 1993. It promotes ethical business practices in the travel industry and represents the interests of travel agents before government bodies and IATA.

name: Association of Indian Universities (AIU)
short_description: Apex body of universities in India.
description: AIU is the apex body of universities in India, established in 1925. It facilitates and promotes academic, cultural and sports activities among universities and is responsible for equivalence of foreign degrees.

name: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
short_description: Statutory body regulating technical education in India.
description: AICTE is the statutory body and a national-level council for technical education in India. It is responsible for proper planning and co-ordinated development of the technical education and management education system in India.

name: Advertising Standards Council of India (ASCI)
short_description: Self-regulatory body of the advertising industry in India.
description: ASCI is the self-regulatory organisation of the advertising industry in India, set up in 1985. It ensures advertisements are honest, truthful, and not offensive, working to maintain standards in advertising through its Code for Self-Regulation.

name: Indian Newspaper Society (INS)
short_description: Apex body of newspaper and news agency publishers in India.
description: The Indian Newspaper Society is the apex body of newspaper and news agency publishers in India, founded in 1939. It represents over 1,100 member publications across the country and works to uphold press freedom and newspaper industry interests.

name: All India Food Processors' Association (AIFPA)
short_description: Apex body of food processing industry in India.
description: AIFPA is the apex body of food processors in India. Established in 1943, it represents the interests of the food processing industry and liaises with government bodies on policy matters related to food processing and exports.

name: National Seeds Association of India (NSAI)
short_description: Apex body of the seed industry in India.
description: NSAI is the apex body of the seed industry in India, representing private sector seed companies. It advocates for seed policy reforms, seed quality, and technology adoption to ensure food security.

name: APEDA ??Agricultural & Processed Food Products Export Development Authority
short_description: Government authority promoting export of agricultural produce.
description: APEDA was established under the Agricultural and Processed Food Products Export Development Authority Act 1985. It is responsible for the promotion and development of export of agricultural and processed food products from India.

name: Indian Wind Energy Association (InWEA)
short_description: Apex body representing India's wind energy industry.
description: InWEA is the nodal agency for the Indian wind energy sector and represents the interests of wind energy developers, manufacturers, and service providers. It works to promote wind energy adoption and advocates for a favourable policy environment.

name: Solar Energy Society of India (SESI)
short_description: Professional society for solar energy in India.
description: SESI is a scientific and engineering society that promotes the development and utilisation of solar energy in India. It provides a platform for researchers, engineers, and industry professionals working in renewable energy.

name: IEEMA Power Equipment Forum
short_description: Apex representative of India's power equipment sector.
description: As part of IEEMA's power equipment segment, this forum represents manufacturers of power transformers, switchgear, cables, and energy meters. It advocates for domestic manufacturing under Make in India and energy transition initiatives.

name: All India Motor Transport Congress (AIMTC)
short_description: Apex body of road transport operators in India.
description: AIMTC is the apex body of the road transport sector in India, representing over 95 lakh transport operators. It is the voice of truckers and transport operators and works to address issues related to freight and logistics.

name: Container Shipping Lines Association (CSLA)
short_description: Association of container shipping lines operating in India.
description: CSLA represents container shipping lines operating in and out of India. It provides a platform for shipping lines to address common industry issues, especially those related to India's trade and maritime policy.

name: Air Cargo Agents Association of India (ACAAI)
short_description: National body of air cargo agents in India.
description: ACAAI is the apex body representing air cargo agents in India. Founded in 1967, it promotes the interests of IATA-accredited cargo agents and coordinates between airlines, shippers and freight forwarders.

name: Retailers Association of India (RAI)
short_description: Industry body representing the retail business in India.
description: RAI is an industry body representing the retail business in India. Founded in 2004, it works with government and other stakeholders to develop the retail sector, and represents retailers of all formats and sizes.

name: Indian Staffing Federation (ISF)
short_description: National body of staffing industry in India.
description: ISF is the national body of the staffing industry in India. It represents over 100 staffing companies that collectively employ millions of flexi-staff across industries and is the official body for policy advocacy in the workforce staffing space.

name: National HRD Network (NHRD)
short_description: Professional body for HR professionals in India.
description: National HRD Network is the apex body of HR professionals in India, founded in 1985. It facilitates sharing of knowledge and best practices in human resource management and plays a vital role in the professional development of HR practitioners.

name: Bar Council of India (BCI)
short_description: Statutory body regulating legal practice in India.
description: The Bar Council of India is a statutory body established under the Advocates Act, 1961 that regulates legal practice and legal education in India. It prescribes standards for legal education and grants recognition to law universities.

name: Federation of Indian Micro and Small & Medium Enterprises (FISME)
short_description: Apex body for MSMEs in India.
description: FISME is one of the largest MSME representative bodies in India. Formed in 1995, it advocates for the 63 million+ MSMEs in India and collaborates with government agencies, international organisations and industry bodies to promote SME growth.

name: All India Association of Industries (AIAI)
short_description: Representing large and medium industries across India.
description: AIAI is one of the oldest and most respected industrial associations in India, established in 1956. It represents large and medium-sized industries across various sectors and works to promote industrialisation and economic development.

name: Laghu Udyog Bharati (LUB)
short_description: National organisation for small enterprises with nationalistic outlook.
description: Laghu Udyog Bharati is a nationalist organisation for small industries in India, founded in 1994. It advocates for policies that support small enterprises and promotes Swadeshi manufacturing through its extensive network across Indian states.

name: Builders Association of India (BAI)
short_description: National body of civil engineering construction contractors.
description: BAI, founded in 1941, is the national body of civil engineering construction contractors in India. It represents contractors working on roads, bridges, dams, buildings, and other infrastructure projects and has over 18,000 members across the country.

name: Federation of Indian Airlines (FIA)
short_description: Industry body representing scheduled airline operators in India.
description: FIA represents the collective interests of scheduled airline operators in India. It engages with regulatory bodies including DGCA, Ministry of Civil Aviation, and AAI, and advocates for a supportive policy framework for civil aviation growth.

name: Gems & Jewellery Export Promotion Council (GJEPC)
short_description: Official body for promotion of gems and jewellery exports.
description: GJEPC, set up in 1966 by the Ministry of Commerce, is the apex body for the promotion of gem and jewellery exports from India. It has over 8,000 members and helps members participate in international exhibitions and trade fairs.

name: All India Gems and Jewellery Domestic Council (GJC)
short_description: National body for domestic gems and jewellery trade.
description: GJC is the largest domestic trade body for the gems and jewellery sector in India, representing over 3 lakh jewellery retailers and manufacturers. It promotes the domestic jewellery market and acts as the voice of the industry before government.

name: Cellular Operators Association of India (COAI)
short_description: Apex industry body for cellular and telecom operators.
description: COAI is the apex industry body for cellular, mobile and telecom operators in India. Founded in 1995, it represents major telecom operators and works towards the creation of a conducive policy framework for the telecom industry.

name: Indian Chamber of Commerce (ICC) ??Telecom Forum
short_description: Regional body promoting telecom sector growth in eastern India.
description: The ICC Telecom Forum is an industry group under the Indian Chamber of Commerce that focuses on telecom and ICT sector development in eastern and north-eastern India, engaging with operators, vendors, and government regulators.

name: National Horticulture Board (NHB)
short_description: Government body promoting horticulture development across India.
description: NHB is a national level organisation established in 1984 under the Ministry of Agriculture. It supports development of commercial horticulture and provides assistance for development of pre and post-harvest infrastructure.

name: Indian Fresh Produce Association (IFPA)
short_description: Industry body for fresh fruits and vegetables sector in India.
description: IFPA India promotes the interests of fresh produce supply chain stakeholders. It facilitates industry dialogue on cold chain development, post-harvest management, and global market access for Indian fresh produce.

name: Spices Board of India
short_description: Statutory body promoting Indian spices globally.
description: Spices Board of India is a statutory body under the Ministry of Commerce & Industry, set up in 1987. It is responsible for the development and worldwide promotion of Indian spices and regulates the export of spices from India.

name: Cashew Export Promotion Council (CEPCI)
short_description: Government-supported body promoting cashew exports from India.
description: CEPCI, established in 1955, is the apex body for the cashew industry in India. It promotes the export of cashew kernels and allied products from India and provides support to members for participation in global trade events.

name: Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI)
short_description: National governing body for cricket in India.
description: BCCI is the national governing body for cricket in India. Founded in 1928, it is the richest cricket board in the world and manages India's national cricket teams, domestic competitions, and the Indian Premier League (IPL).

name: All India Football Federation (AIFF)
short_description: Governing body of football in India.
description: AIFF is the governing body for football in India, established in 1937. It is affiliated to FIFA and the Asian Football Confederation and manages the Indian National Football Team and domestic league competitions.

name: Hockey India
short_description: National governing body for field hockey in India.
description: Hockey India is the national governing body for field hockey in India. It is affiliated to International Hockey Federation (FIH) and the Asian Hockey Federation and manages the national teams and domestic competitions including the Hockey India League.

name: Athletics Federation of India (AFI)
short_description: Governing body of athletics in India.
description: AFI is the national governing body for athletics in India, affiliated to World Athletics and the Asian Athletics Association. It organises national championships, selects and manages athletes for international competitions.

name: Badminton Association of India (BAI)
short_description: National governing body for badminton in India.
description: BAI is the governing body for badminton in India, founded in 1934. It is affiliated to the Badminton World Federation and manages the national badminton teams and organises competitions like the National Badminton Championship.

name: Wrestling Federation of India (WFI)
short_description: National governing body for wrestling in India.
description: WFI is the national federation for wrestling in India, affiliated to United World Wrestling (UWW) and Asian Wrestling Confederation. It governs freestyle, Greco-Roman, and women's wrestling in India.

name: Table Tennis Federation of India (TTFI)
short_description: Governing body for table tennis in India.
description: TTFI is the national federation for table tennis in India, affiliated to the International Table Tennis Federation (ITTF) and Asian Table Tennis Union. It promotes the sport through national championships and development programmes.

name: Volleyball Federation of India (VFI)
short_description: National governing body for volleyball in India.
description: VFI is the national governing body for volleyball in India, affiliated to FIVB and Asian Volleyball Confederation. It manages national volleyball teams and organises competitions including the National Volleyball Championship.

name: Boxing Federation of India (BFI)
short_description: National governing body for boxing in India.
description: BFI is the national federation for amateur boxing in India, affiliated to World Boxing (WB) and Asian Boxing Confederation. It selects and trains boxers for international competition including the Olympics.

name: Weightlifting Federation of India (WFI-WL)
short_description: National governing body for weightlifting in India.
description: The Weightlifting Federation of India is affiliated to IWF and Asian Weightlifting Federation. It governs Olympic weightlifting, organises national championships, and selects athletes for international competition.

name: Healthcare Federation of India (NATHEALTH)
short_description: Apex body for private healthcare industry in India.
description: NATHEALTH is the apex body for private healthcare in India. Founded in 2012, it represents hospitals, pharmacies, diagnostics, medical devices, and digital health companies working to address India's healthcare challenges.

name: Association of Diagnostics Manufacturers of India (ADMI)
short_description: Industry body for diagnostic manufacturers in India.
description: ADMI represents manufacturers of in vitro diagnostics (IVD) products in India. It advocates for a supportive regulatory environment for the diagnostics sector and promotes quality standards in diagnostic manufacturing.

name: Digital Health Association of India (DHAI)
short_description: Industry body for digital health ecosystem in India.
description: DHAI represents companies involved in digital health including telemedicine, health IT, AI in healthcare, and health data management. It works to advance the digital health ecosystem and support regulatory development in this space.

name: Association of Indian Medical Device Industry (AiMeD)
short_description: Industry body for domestic medical device manufacturers.
description: AiMeD is the Forum for Indian Medical Device industry, representing manufacturers of medical devices and diagnostics. It promotes Make in India in the medical devices sector and engages with CDSCO on regulatory policy matters.

name: Franchise Association of India (FAI)
short_description: National body for the franchise industry in India.
description: FAI is the national apex body representing the franchise industry in India. Founded in 2008, it promotes franchising as a business model, sets ethical standards, and represents the franchise sector before government and regulatory bodies.

name: Maharashtra Chamber of Commerce, Industry and Agriculture (MACCIA)
short_description: Premier chamber of commerce for Maharashtra state.
description: MACCIA is the apex chamber of commerce for Maharashtra, representing thousands of businessmen across the state. Founded in 1927, it advocates for industry-friendly policies and organises trade delegations, exhibitions, and business development programmes.

name: Federation of Karnataka Chambers of Commerce and Industry (FKCCI)
short_description: Apex chamber of commerce for Karnataka state.
description: FKCCI, founded in 1916, is the apex chamber of commerce for Karnataka. It represents the trade and industry interests of the state, facilitates investment, and advocates for industry-friendly policy changes with state and central governments.

name: Tamil Nadu Chamber of Commerce and Industry (TNCCI)
short_description: Apex chamber for trade and industry in Tamil Nadu.
description: TNCCI represents the business community of Tamil Nadu. Established in 1911, it is one of the oldest chambers in southern India and works to promote trade, industry, and commerce in the state through advocacy and business development initiatives.

name: Bengal Chamber of Commerce & Industry (BCC&I)
short_description: Oldest chamber of commerce in Asia.
description: Bengal Chamber of Commerce & Industry, founded in 1853, is the oldest chamber of commerce in Asia. It represents the business community of West Bengal and eastern India, facilitates trade, and provides a platform for industry advocacy and networking.

name: Gujarat Chamber of Commerce and Industry (GCCI)
short_description: Premier chamber representing industry and trade in Gujarat.
description: GCCI, established in 1949, is the premier chamber of commerce for Gujarat. It represents a wide range of industries and commercial establishments in the state and acts as a bridge between industry and government.

name: Kerala Chamber of Commerce and Industry (KCCI)
short_description: Representative body for trade and industry in Kerala.
description: KCCI is the apex body representing commerce and industry in Kerala. It works to promote and develop trade, industry, and the economy of the state by liaising with government bodies and providing services to members.

name: Rajasthan Chamber of Commerce and Industry (RCCI)
short_description: Apex chamber representing Rajasthan's trade and industry.
description: RCCI is the apex chamber of commerce for Rajasthan, established in 1948. It represents trade, industry, and commerce across the state and advocates for policies conducive to Rajasthan's economic development.

name: Indian Merchants' Chamber (IMC)
short_description: Premier chamber of commerce headquartered in Mumbai.
description: IMC is one of the premier chambers of commerce in India, founded in 1907. It represents commerce, trade and industry interests primarily in Maharashtra and engages on issues like ease of doing business and economic policy.

name: Federation of Seed Industry of India (FSII)
short_description: National body of the seed industry promoting innovation.
description: FSII is the national federation for the seed industry in India, representing companies involved in research, development and marketing of seeds. It advocates for science-based seed policies including IPR protection for plant varieties.

name: Agri Business and Food Federation of India (AgBIF)
short_description: Apex body for agribusiness and food enterprises in India.
description: AgBIF promotes the interests of agribusiness companies, food processors, and agri-tech startups in India. It focuses on technology adoption in agriculture, food safety standards, and facilitating farm-to-market connections.

name: CropLife India
short_description: Industry body of crop protection companies in India.
description: CropLife India is the industry body of crop protection companies in India. It represents companies that develop, manufacture and market pesticides, herbicides, and other crop protection products, and advocates for science-based regulation.

name: Indian Steel Association (ISA)
short_description: Industry body representing major steel producers in India.
description: ISA represents major integrated and secondary steel producers in India. Founded in 2014, it works to promote the growth of the Indian steel industry and advocates for steel-friendly policies on trade, energy, and infrastructure.

name: ASSOCHAM Metals & Mining Forum
short_description: Industry forum for metals and mining under ASSOCHAM.
description: ASSOCHAM Metals Forum provides a platform for companies in the metals, mining, and minerals sector. It facilitates dialogue between industry, government, and global players on policy, technology, and sustainability in metals.

name: Federation of Indian Mineral Industries (FIMI)
short_description: Apex body of mining and mineral-based industries in India.
description: FIMI is the apex body of the mining industry in India, established in 1966. It represents the interests of companies engaged in exploration, mining, and processing of minerals and advocates for a conducive mining policy environment.

name: Indian Paper Manufacturers Association (IPMA)
short_description: Apex body of the paper manufacturing industry in India.
description: IPMA is the premier organisation of paper manufacturers in India. Established in 1951, it represents major paper mills and works to promote paper industry interests in India, including raw material availability, taxation, and environmental compliance.

name: The Energy and Resources Institute (TERI)
short_description: Leading research body on environment and energy in India.
description: The Energy and Resources Institute (TERI) is a leading think tank and research organisation working in the fields of energy, environment, climate change, and sustainable development. It conducts policy research, capacity building and consultancy.

name: Indian Private Equity & Venture Capital Association (IVCA)
short_description: Apex body for PE and VC industry in India.
description: IVCA is the apex body of the private equity and venture capital industry in India. Established in 1992, it promotes the PE/VC industry through policy advocacy, education, and networking, and aims to make India the most preferred investment destination.

name: TiE (The Indus Entrepreneurs)
short_description: World's largest entrepreneurship network with Indian roots.
description: TiE is a global non-profit organisation focused on the advancement of entrepreneurship. Founded in Silicon Valley in 1992 by Indian-American entrepreneurs, it has 61 chapters worldwide with a strong presence in India, nurturing entrepreneurs through mentorship and networking.

name: India Furniture Products Manufacturers' Association (IFPMA)
short_description: National body of furniture industry in India.
description: IFPMA represents the furniture manufacturing industry in India. It promotes domestic furniture production, advocates for industry-friendly policies, and facilitates participation of Indian furniture companies in global trade events.

name: Indian Dairy Association (IDA)
short_description: Apex body of dairy industry in India.
description: IDA is the national apex body of the dairy industry in India. Founded in 1948, it represents dairy farmers, processors, manufacturers, and distributors. It promotes dairy technology, education, and policy advocacy for the sector.

name: All India Federation of Master Printers (AIFMP)
short_description: Apex body of printing industry in India.
description: AIFMP is the apex body of the printing industry in India, founded in 1958. It represents printing firms across the country and works to advance the printing and graphic arts industry through policy advocacy, training, and exhibitions.

name: Fire & Security Association of India (FSAI)
short_description: National body for fire protection and security industry.
description: FSAI is the national body representing the fire detection, suppression, and security industry in India. It works to promote fire safety awareness, standardise products, and engages with Bureau of Indian Standards on fire safety norms.

name: Council for Leather Exports (CLE)
short_description: Apex export promotion body for leather sector.
description: Council for Leather Exports is the apex export promotion body for the leather sector in India, established in 1984. It promotes exports of leather, leather goods, and footwear, and assists member exporters with market access and trade facilitation.

name: All India Footwear Manufacturers & Retailers Association (AIFMRA)
short_description: National body for footwear industry in India.
description: AIFMRA represents footwear manufacturers and retailers in India. It supports the domestic footwear industry through policy advocacy, organises trade fairs, and facilitates technology upgradation for small footwear manufacturers.

name: All India Rubber Industries Association (AIRIA)
short_description: Apex body of the rubber industry in India.
description: AIRIA is the apex body of the rubber industry in India, founded in 1941. It represents rubber product manufacturers, processes, and traders, and works to promote the growth of the rubber sector in India.

name: Council of Architecture (COA)
short_description: Statutory body for regulation of architectural profession.
description: The Council of Architecture is a statutory body constituted under the Architects Act, 1972. It regulates the education and practice of the profession of Architecture in India and maintains the Register of Architects.

name: Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI)
short_description: National professional accounting body in India.
description: ICAI is the national professional accounting body of India. Established in 1949 by an Act of Parliament, it regulates the profession of chartered accountants in India and has over 3.5 lakh members and 8 lakh students.

name: Institute of Cost Accountants of India (ICMAI)
short_description: Statutory body for cost and management accountants.
description: ICMAI, formerly the Institute of Cost and Works Accountants of India (ICWAI), is a statutory body established in 1959. It regulates the profession of cost and management accountants and promotes excellence in management accounting.

name: Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI)
short_description: Statutory body for company secretaries in India.
description: ICSI is a statutory body constituted under the Company Secretaries Act, 1980. It regulates and develops the profession of company secretaries in India and has over 65,000 members and 2 lakh students enrolled.

name: Indian National Shipowners' Association (INSA)
short_description: Apex body of ship owners and operators in India.
description: INSA is the apex body of Indian ship-owning and ship-operating companies. Established in 1929, it promotes the Indian shipping industry, advocates for the interests of ship owners before government, and represents India in international maritime bodies.

name: Carpet Export Promotion Council (CEPC)
short_description: Government body for promotion of carpet exports from India.
description: CEPC, established in 1982, is the nodal body for promotion of carpet exports from India. It assists manufacturers and exporters of hand-knotted, handloom, tufted, and machine-made carpets in building global markets.

name: Handloom Export Promotion Council (HEPC)
short_description: Council promoting export of handloom products from India.
description: HEPC is a government-backed body for the promotion of exports of handloom products. It assists handloom manufacturers and exporters of India to explore and develop overseas markets for handloom fabrics and made-ups.

name: iSPIRT (Indian Software Product Industry Round Table)
short_description: Think tank and volunteer organisation for software product companies.
description: ISPIRT is a think tank and volunteer organisation for software product companies in India. Founded by software industry veterans, it focuses on policy advocacy, market development, and playbooks for product entrepreneurs, and also drives initiatives like India Stack.

name: India Electronics & Semiconductor Association (IESA)
short_description: Apex body of electronics and semiconductor industry in India.
description: IESA is the apex body of the electronics and semiconductor ecosystem in India. It promotes design, innovation, and manufacturing in electronics and works closely with the Ministry of Electronics and IT on industry development initiatives.

name: Indian Sugar Mills Association (ISMA)
short_description: Apex body of sugar industry in India.
description: ISMA is the apex body of the Indian sugar industry, established in 1932. It represents large sugar mills across the country and works with the government on sugar pricing, export subsidies, ethanol policy, and sugarcane-related matters.

name: Logistics Sector Skill Council (LSSC)
short_description: Sector skill council for skill development in logistics.
description: LSSC is the sector skill council for logistics in India, set up under the National Skill Development Corporation. It develops occupational standards and qualification packs for logistics jobs and promotes skilling of the logistics workforce.

name: General Insurance Council of India
short_description: Body representing non-life insurance companies in India.
description: The General Insurance Council represents the non-life or general insurance companies in India. Constituted under the Insurance Act, 1938, it aims at promoting the spread of general insurance and looks after common industry interests.

name: Indian Public Health Association (IPHA)
short_description: National body of public health professionals in India.
description: IPHA, established in 1956, is the national body of public health professionals in India. It promotes the science and practice of public health through conferences, publications, and training programmes, and advises on public health policy.

name: Information Sharing and Analysis Center (ISAC) India
short_description: Cybersecurity threat intelligence sharing body for critical sectors.
description: ISAC India facilitates sharing of cybersecurity threat intelligence among financial and other critical sector organisations in India. It works closely with CERT-In and the National Critical Information Infrastructure Protection Centre.

name: Association of Biotechnology Led Enterprises (ABLE)
short_description: Industry body for biotechnology companies in India.
description: ABLE is the industry body for companies in the biotechnology sector in India. It represents biotech startups, mid-sized companies, and large enterprises working in health biotech, agri-biotech, and industrial biotech.

name: Society of Indian Defence Manufacturers (SIDM)
short_description: Industry body for defence manufacturing in India.
description: SIDM is the industry body for the Indian defence manufacturing sector, set up under the aegis of CII. It promotes the indigenisation of defence equipment and represents the private sector defence industry before the Ministry of Defence.

name: Indian Space Association (ISpA)
short_description: Premier industry association of space and satellite companies.
description: ISpA is the premier industry association of space and satellite companies in India. Launched in 2021, it represents major private space companies and advocates for a progressive space policy to enable India's private space sector.

name: All India Ophthalmological Society (AIOS)
short_description: National body of eye specialists in India.
description: AIOS is the national body of ophthalmologists in India, founded in 1930. With over 20,000 members, it promotes advances in ophthalmology through annual conferences, journals, and continuing medical education programmes.

name: Federation of Indian Women Entrepreneurs (FIWE)
short_description: National body promoting women entrepreneurship in India.
description: FIWE is a non-profit organisation dedicated to promoting and facilitating women entrepreneurship in India. It provides networking, training, and advocacy support to women business owners across sectors.

name: Insurance Brokers Association of India (IBAI)
short_description: National body of licensed insurance brokers in India.
description: IBAI is the national body representing licensed insurance brokers in India. It promotes professional standards in insurance broking, advocates for policy changes, and provides a platform for information exchange among member brokers.

name: National Cooperative Union of India (NCUI)
short_description: Apex national body for cooperative movement in India.
description: NCUI is the apex body at the national level for the cooperative movement in India. Established in 1929, it provides leadership and guidance to the cooperative movement and promotes cooperative principles and practices across sectors.

name: AVGC-XR Industry Association of India
short_description: Industry body for India's animation, VFX, gaming and XR sector.
description: This association represents companies in the Animation, VFX, Gaming, Comics and Extended Reality (AVGC-XR) sectors. It advocates for policy support, promotes skill development, and positions India as a global AVGC hub.

name: Payments Council of India (PCI)
short_description: Industry body for payment system operators in India.
description: PCI is the industry body of payment system operators in India, set up in 2013 under the umbrella of IAMAI. It represents over 100 organisations in the payment ecosystem and advocates for a digital payment-friendly policy environment.

name: Fintech Association for Consumer Empowerment (FACE)
short_description: Self-regulatory body for digital lending industry in India.
description: FACE is a self-regulatory organisation for the digital lending sector in India. It works to promote responsible digital lending practices, consumer protection, and fair lending codes among fintech companies involved in digital credit.

name: Institute of Indian Interior Designers (IIID)
short_description: Professional body for interior designers in India.
description: IIID is the professional body for interior designers in India, established in 1972. It promotes the profession of interior design, sets practice standards, and facilitates professional development among its members across 22 chapters nationwide.

name: Basic Chemicals, Cosmetics & Dyes Export Promotion Council (CHEMEXCIL)
short_description: Export promotion body for basic chemicals, cosmetics and dyes.
description: CHEMEXCIL, established in 1963, is the apex export promotion body for basic chemicals, cosmetics, toiletries, soaps, detergents, agrochemicals, and dyes from India. It helps member exporters access global markets.

name: Sports Goods Export Promotion Council (SGEPC)
short_description: Export promotion body for Indian sports goods.
description: SGEPC promotes the export of sports goods, outdoor and recreational games equipment and articles from India. India is a major global producer of sports goods and SGEPC facilitates market access for member companies worldwide.

name: National Highway Builders Federation (NHBF)
short_description: Apex body of highway infrastructure construction companies.
description: NHBF represents companies in the highway and road infrastructure construction sector. It works with NHAI and Ministry of Road Transport on policy matters, contractor welfare, and ensuring timely project completion.

name: National Cold Chain Development Council (NCCD)
short_description: Government advisory body for cold chain in India.
description: NCCD was established in 2010 as a government advisory body under the Ministry of Agriculture to guide the development of cold chain infrastructure in India, especially for perishable agricultural produce.

name: Solar Power Developers Association (SPDA)
short_description: Industry body for solar power project developers in India.
description: SPDA represents solar power project developers in India. It advocates for stable solar energy policy, long-term power purchase agreements, and a level playing field for independent power producers in the solar segment.

name: Consumer Electronics and Appliances Manufacturers Association (CEAMA)
short_description: Industry body for consumer electronics and home appliances.
description: CEAMA represents manufacturers of consumer electronics and home appliances in India. It was established to advocate for industry interests before government bodies and regulatory authorities, and to promote the growth of the consumer electronics sector.

name: Ayush Industry Chamber (AIC)
short_description: Industry body for Ayurveda, Yoga, Unani, Siddha and Homeopathy sector.
description: AIC represents companies in the AYUSH (Ayurveda, Yoga, Unani, Siddha, Homeopathy) sector. It promotes traditional Indian medicine systems, advocates for supportive AYUSH regulation, and works to globalise Indian wellness and herbal products.

name: Microfinance Institutions Network (MFIN)
short_description: Industry association and self-regulatory body for India's microfinance sector.
description: MFIN (Microfinance Institutions Network) is the industry association and self-regulatory organisation for the NBFC-MFI (Non-Banking Finance Company - Microfinance Institution) sector in India. It promotes responsible microfinance practices and represents microfinance institutions before regulators and the government.

name: IndiaAI Mission Industry Consortium
short_description: Government-led initiative for AI ecosystem in India.
description: IndiaAI is the government's flagship mission to develop a robust AI ecosystem in India. The industry consortium under IndiaAI brings together AI companies, startups, and research organisations to collaborate on AI compute, datasets, and application development for national priorities.

name: Indian Wind Turbine Manufacturers Association (IWTMA)
short_description: Apex business association and voice of the Indian wind industry.
description: Established in 1998, IWTMA is the apex business association and voice of the Indian Wind Industry, working with Central and State policymakers, investors, and stakeholders to develop India's wind power sector.
